description: The four initial program codes are \(0,1,2,3\). For subprograms with codes \(a,b\), pairing, composition and primitive recursion have codes \(4\langle a,b\rangle+4\), \(4\langle a,b\rangle+6\) and \(4\langle a,b\rangle+5\); search has code \(4a+7\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.encoding_equations (c d : Nat.Partrec.Code) :
  Encodable.encode Nat.Partrec.Code.zero = 0 ∧
    Encodable.encode Nat.Partrec.Code.succ = 1 ∧
      Encodable.encode Nat.Partrec.Code.left = 2 ∧
        Encodable.encode Nat.Partrec.Code.right = 3 ∧
          Encodable.encode (c.pair d) = 4 * Nat.pair (Encodable.encode c) (Encodable.encode d) + 4 ∧
            Encodable.encode (c.comp d) = 4 * Nat.pair (Encodable.encode c) (Encodable.encode d) + 6 ∧
              Encodable.encode (c.prec d) = 4 * Nat.pair (Encodable.encode c) (Encodable.encode d) + 5 ∧
                Encodable.encode c.rfind' = 4 * Encodable.encode c + 7
